meta.name: copy-editing
meta.description: When the user wants to edit, review, or improve existing marketing copy, or refresh outdated content. Also use when the user mentions 'edit this copy,' 'review my copy,' 'copy feedback,' 'proofread,' 'polish this,' 'make this better,' 'copy sweep,' 'tighten this up,' 'this reads awkwardly,' 'clean up this text,' 'too wordy,' 'sharpen the messaging,' 'refresh this content,' 'update this page,' 'this content is outdated,' or 'content audit.' Use this when the user already has copy and wants it improved or refreshed rather than rewritten from scratch. For writing new copy, see copywriting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 润色和优化现有营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你已有营销文案需要改进或刷新
copy.tagline_en: Polish and improve existing marketing copy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have existing marketing copy that needs improvement or refresh

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按七个步骤（清晰度、语气、价值、证据、具体性、情感、消除风险）逐遍检查并改进你已有的营销文案，保留原意，只做增强。
howto.when: 当你给出已有文案，要求编辑、审阅、改进或刷新时触发。例如说“编辑这段文案”、“审阅我的文案”、“润色一下”等。

say.text: 帮我编辑这段产品介绍，让它更清晰。
say.note: Claude 会从清晰度开始逐遍优化。

say.text: 审阅我的着陆页文案，检查是否有证据支撑。
say.note: Claude 会检查每个主张是否有证据。

say.text: 润色这封营销邮件，让情感更强烈。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will review and improve your existing marketing copy through seven sequential passes (clarity, voice, value, proof, specificity, emotion, risk reduction), preserving the original message while enhancing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide existing copy and ask to edit, review, improve, or refresh it. For example, saying 'edit this copy,' 'review my copy,' 'polish this,' etc.

say_en.text: Edit this product description to make it clearer.
say_en.note: Claude will start with the clarity sweep.

say_en.text: Review my landing page copy for proof.
say_en.note: Claude will check each claim for evidence.

say_en.text: Polish this marketing email to heighten emotion.
